body:
History: No benzo tolerance. I usually use them for around 6 months on and then 6 months off. I suffer from social anxiety and depression.
Tablets were small 5mg hot pink coloured. Very pleasurable headspace starts about 45 minutes after ingesting 5mg. About 20 minutes later the awesome euphoria and anxiolytic effects kick in and they are very profound. More chatty, extreme comfort when laying down and all around just feeling good.
Unfortunately these great feelings only last about 90 minutes tops. I prefer it to Clonazepam which I was last on, but I feel with Deschloroetizolam there's a much higher compulsion to redose once or twice more in the day - even if one has excellent self control
